messages:
sam: Heads-up — ran into a weird parity thing: curl + REST allows an X-Delegate-User header to act on behalf of a user, but Node SDK calls ignore that header and run as the service token.

sam: Repro steps: curl works
sam: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Delegate-User: user:123" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

sam: Node SDK (simple) — this returns as service key, no delegation:
sam: ```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, headers: { 'X-Delegate-User': 'user:123' } });
await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' });
```

sam: Behavior: REST response shows user id from header, SDK response shows service principal.

lina_dev: :eyes: that could break a few onboarding flows that use delegate impersonation for testing. do we think SDK is intentionally blocking that header?

mike_platform: I dug in — SDK normalizes headers and only forwards a small allowlist. X-Delegate-User isn't on it. It was a safety decision to avoid header injection across middleware.

lina_dev: OK makes sense from a security POV, but we need parity or at least clear docs + an explicit API for impersonation. can you add an opt-in param rather than silently dropping it?

mike_platform: Agreed. Proposal: add client option { allowRawHeaders: ['X-Delegate-User'] } or better, explicit param generate({ delegate_user: 'user:123' }) that maps to the header under the hood. More audit-friendly.

sam: explicit param sounds safer to me. also found an odd retry interaction: when SDK retries on 502 it strips the header entirely on retry path — so even if we patched allowlist, retries still lose the delegate header.

mike_platform: yikes — that explains flakiness. looks like retry layer reconstructs request from a sanitized template. will fix so repeated headers are preserved.

lina_dev: Can you file a small RFC? Include: backward-compatible API, opt-in explicit param, retry preservation, tests + changelog. Also add a short note in onboarding quickstart about delegation being opt-in.

mike_platform: Will do. I'll create RFC PR and mark it for review. tagging @sam for repro steps and logs.

ci-bot: test-failure (e2e/impersonation): 1 failing test in pipeline #7823 — failure matches header-loss-on-retry.

sam: attached logs in the bug issue. thanks — this was causing a bunch of test flakes for the sample app that simulates end-users.

lina_dev: Good catch. Once RFC lands we should add a small migration note in SDK changelog and an example in sample-apps.

sam: Yep. Also adding a quick patch in local fork so we can unblock the sample app CI.

mike_platform: I'll prioritize the retry/header preservation fix, then RFC for public API.

sam: Thanks all.
